evidence.notes: AttachmentRetrievalOption overloads use the local stored-template renderer; attachment retrieval is not modeled.
updateEmailTemplateUsage is accepted for shape and ignored because local email usage tracking is not modeled.
The Messaging.Email list overload returns ordered local SendEmailResult values and increments email limits.
The partial URL constructor builds a local PageReference with mutable parameters and headers.
SObject.setOptions stores a cloned Database.DMLOptions value on the local record.
AccessLevel overloads use the deterministic Test.setFixedSearchResults local search model.
AccessLevel overloads use the deterministic Test.setFixedSearchResults local SOSL model.
Search.suggest returns a deterministic empty SuggestionResults DTO without external suggestion service calls.
The AccessLevel overload returns the same deterministic local SuggestionResults DTO.

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingPageSearchOptionsTest { @isTest static void rows() { EmailTemplate tmpl = new EmailTemplate(Name = 'Trail Template', DeveloperName = 'Trail_Template', FolderId = '00l000000000001AAA', Subject = 'Trail subject', Body = 'Trail body', HtmlValue = '

Trail body

'); insert tmpl; Messaging.SingleEmailMessage rendered = Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate(tmpl.Id, null, null, Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.METADATA_ONLY); System.assertEquals('Trail subject', rendered.getSubject()); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage renderedWithUsage = Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate(tmpl.Id, null, null, Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.METADATA_WITH_BODY, false); System.assertEquals('Trail body', renderedWithUsage.getPlainTextBody()); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage single = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); single.setToAddresses(new List{'trail@example.test'}); single.setPlainTextBody('hello'); List emails = new List{single}; List sent = Messaging.sendEmail(emails, false); System.assertEquals(1, sent.size()); System.assert(sent[0].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getEmailInvocations()); PageReference page = new PageReference('/apex/Trail'); page.getParameters().put('id', '001000000000001AAA'); System.assertEquals('/apex/Trail?id=001000000000001AAA', page.getUrl()); Database.DMLOptions opts = new Database.DMLOptions(); opts.optAllOrNone = false; Account optioned = new Account(Name = 'Options'); optioned.setOptions(opts); System.assertEquals(false, optioned.getOptions().optAllOrNone); Account account = new Account(Name = 'Nook Inc'); insert account; Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List{account.Id}); List> rows = Search.query('FIND {Nook*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name)', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, rows[0].size()); Search.SearchResults found = Search.find('FIND {Nook*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name)', AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, found.get('Account').size()); Search.SuggestionOption suggestionOption = new Search.SuggestionOption(); Search.SuggestionResults suggestions = Search.suggest('Nook', 'Account', suggestionOption); System.assertEquals(0, suggestions.getSuggestionResults().size()); Search.SuggestionResults accessSuggestions = Search.suggest('Nook', 'Account', suggestionOption, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(false, accessSuggestions.hasMoreResults()); } }
